## History

Martin was hired to work at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) a year prior to Matthew's death, though he suffered bad luck with livestock as four cows died during his tenure. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's stray Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) thinking it was her own, Martin informed her that their own cow was actually still in the barnyard, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to realize her mistake.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042)_
